notes.title: Release of the soundtrack for the game “Heart of Altai”
notes.notes:
Friends, while our developers are working on updates to the game, we have released the soundtrack “Heart of Altai.”



Each track is filled with sincere emotions and depth, from melancholic melodies to energetic rhythms, allowing you to immerse yourself in the culture and traditions of the local people. This soundtrack does not simply accompany the gameplay; it becomes an integral part of the narrative, enriching each scene and highlighting the unique moments of the adventure.



Heart of Altai is not just a game, but also a special musical experience.



The main song of the album was written by game designer Danila Ermakov, who is also the project's composer. The recording features renowned Altai throat singer Dobrynya Satin, guitarist Evgeny Rudenko from the metal band S.C.A.R.D., Altai singer Galina Tolkochekova, and drummer Anton Brezhnev from the band ILLIDIANCE.



In honor of the album's release, there is a 15% discount.

notes.title: Early access and first day patch
notes.notes:
Friends, we can finally say it: the Heart of Altai game has gone into Early Access and is available for purchase!

As it often happens during releases, today we have already prepared the first day patch thanks to your feedback.

The update includes:

 autoloading edits
 selectable loading of locations
 clickability of locations
 exit from 1 location is available 


The next major update with achievements will be released in 1.5-2 weeks.

If you have been waiting for a sign from above to go on a virtual expedition to one of the most mysterious corners of the planet - Altai, here it is! This is not just a simulator of walks. It is a history of the region with magical nature, original people, unusual traditions and religion.
We have put everything into the project: respect for the Altai Republic, where we have visited ourselves, attention to details and love for beautiful landscapes.

Now it is your turn to discover Altai as we have seen it. Your feedback is very important! We will be guided by the feedback and improve the project.
